faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What's the difference between Free and paid?
faq.a1: Free includes basic models and expert-avatar features for light personal use. Paid tiers (Pro / Team) unlock advanced image / video models, priority compute, longer context, and higher credit quotas.
faq.a2: Each conversation deducts credits based on actual input / output tokens (priced per 1K tokens). You only pay for what you use; if your balance hits zero, new conversations are blocked.
faq.q3: How do I upgrade to Pro / Team?
faq.a3: Click the tier's Upgrade button, sign in to your GeekClaw cloud account, then scan the WeChat or Alipay QR code to complete the purchase. The plan and credits are applied immediately after payment.
faq.a4: Team provides a separate team credit pool shared by all members, independent from personal credits. Removed members revert to their personal quota.
